summary: Google Maps SDK integration (mock mode) verified end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass — /api/maps/directions returns valid encoded polyline + start/end + mocked=true for Mumbai->Pune->Lonavala (~120km), Delhi->Jaipur->Gurugram->Behror (~244km), India-centroid fallback for unknown cities, 422 for origin>300 chars. /api/maps/places/autocomplete returns mock_mumbai for 'mum', enforces min_length=2 and requires session_token. Payments/rides/bookings/wallet regressions clean — no side effects from maps module import. Frontend: Home PlaceField debounce (300ms) triggers /api/maps/places/autocomplete, dropdown shows testID from-input-suggestion-mock_mumbai and tapping fills the field with 'Mumbai'. Ride Details page shows a Leaflet map (via <iframe srcDoc>) with polyline + start/end pins and a route-eta-pill showing '2h 40m · 120.2 km' (Mumbai->Pune) and '5h 25m · 243.8 km' (Delhi->Jaipur). Live Tracking renders map + orange car driver marker on polyline; testID live-eta counts down (2h 48m -> 2h 41m within 5s) and SOS FAB is present. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch) found. Only console noise is RN-web 'shadow* style props deprecated' warnings.

issues: Seat count displays '-1 seats' — a prior test run decremented seats_available below zero (no lower-bound guard in PATCH /api/bookings when status=accepted). Data-only; not a maps issue but worth guarding.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/RideMap.tsx and /app/frontend/src/theme.ts. Low priority but should migrate to boxShadow for future RN-web compatibility.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Guard PATCH /api/bookings so ride.seats_available cannot go below 0 when a booking with more seats than remaining is accepted — currently causes UI to show '-1 seats' after repeated test runs.
(Optional/low priority) Replace deprecated 'shadow*' RN style props with 'boxShadow' in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts and /app/frontend/src/components/RideMap.tsx to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: maps.py correctly gates real Google API behind maps_configured() and gracefully falls back to _mock_route on httpx errors or non-OK Google responses — good defensive design.
backend/maps.py caches Google responses in MongoDB (map_cache) keyed by SHA-256 of params (with key stripped) — cost-optimized.
Frontend RideMap.tsx uses <iframe srcDoc> on web and react-native-webview on native — clean universal component. Consumers won't need changes when swapping to react-native-maps later.
PlaceField uses per-field session_token that resets on selection — matches Google Places billing best practice.
No React Native red-screen errors observed; all text is inside <Text> components.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 flows: autocomplete, ride-details map+ETA, live-tracking map+countdown+SOS, Leaflet iframe render)
